items.rationale: The permanently wired unit is insured under 4.2.3, and at about seven metres from the hob it is outside the five-metre exclusion in 2.3.10(c). Under 7.1.9–7.1.10, €1,450 gross allows for like-for-like supply only; no deductible amount is stated.

At about two metres from the hob, the unit is excluded from lightning-surge cover by 2.3.10(c), and no kitchen climate endorsement is in force. The €1,050 gross figure is a conditional supply estimate only.
Section 7.1.9(c) covers the labour to remove the affected unit, fit and connect its replacement, and commission it. €480 gross allows for ordinary installation labour without a premium surcharge.
Under 7.1.11, installation follows the principal item, which is excluded by 2.3.10(c). The €420 gross figure is a conditional labour estimate only.

Section 7.1.9(b) covers a like-for-like support needed to install the replacement when the old one cannot be reused. The scorched console meets that test; €150 gross allows for an equivalent stand, not a decorative upgrade.

Sections 7.1.11–7.1.12 cover ordinary freight only in the living-room unit's share, apportioned by value unless freight was billed by weight or volume. Applying the estimated value share of €1,450 out of €2,500 to €100 gross shared freight gives €58, subject to an itemised split if required.
